title: The Dragon Vein Emerges
next_chapter_hook: Before the words of the first strategist of the Crown Prince's Manor could even finish, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's dantian suddenly burned hot—it was a violent reaction it had never before displayed, as if responding to some kind of summoning from the depths of destiny.

text.content:
The imperial envoy's entourage had already appeared at the periphery of the Tianji Palace. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented pressure—and within that aura was mixed the distinctive oppression of the 'Heavenly Fate Judgment,' causing the Tianji Record Fragment in his dantian to tremble violently.

He stood with hands clasped behind his back beneath the palace corridor, his expression as usual, only a cold glint flickering in the depths of his eyes.

It came. Even faster than he had anticipated.

Three days ago, he had glimpsed this strand of fate's trajectory through the Tianji Record. At that time, it was still a blurry causal thread, but now it had become painfully clear—the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds, the ancient Dragon Vein, and the name he had been searching for all these years.

Chen Tianming.

His brother, missing for so many years, was actually connected to the Imperial Dynasty, the Dragon Vein, and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

Ninety-nine golden-patterned banners fluttered violently in the morning wind, the five-clawed golden dragons embroidered on them seeming ready to break through the cloth.

At the very front of the entourage was a fully black gilded soft sedan, the jade chimes hanging from its four corners producing clear, melodious sounds that formed an eerie harmony with that oppressive aura.

"The Crown Prince's Manor arrives! All irrelevant persons, withdraw!"

A loud shout that made the servant disciples outside Tianji Palace change color, some even having their legs go weak and kneeling on the ground.

Chen Ji remained unmoved, only slightly narrowing his eyes.

The Crown Prince's Manor. He had clashed secretly with Imperial City forces several times in the Tianqing Sect's chess game, but had never made direct contact with the core figures. Today's display was clearly not a social call.

dialogue.content:
The sedan curtain swayed without wind, and a tall, slender figure slowly stepped out.

It was a middle-aged scholar dressed in dark cyan Confucian robes, wearing a white jade crown, his features gaunt yet his presence overwhelming. His gaze swept across the lintel of Tianji Palace before finally landing on Chen Ji, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his mouth.

"Long have I heard the great name of Chen Ji, junior brother of the Tianqing Sect. Today, seeing him in person, he truly is—"

He paused, as if searching for the right words.

"—extraordinary."

Chen Ji stared expressionlessly back at him, but in his heart, violent waves were churning.

He knew this man.

Zhao Xuance. The first strategist of the Crown Prince's Manor, known as 'Half a Step to Heaven,' it was said his wisdom could pierce Heavenly Secrets and reverse causality, making him the most trusted right-hand man of that eternal emperor of the Imperial City.

Such a figure, arriving in person.

text.content:
"Mr. Zhao's personal visit fills Chen Ji with deep honor."

Chen Ji slightly cupped his hands in greeting, his tone as flat as if he were greeting a neighbor.

A flash of surprise crossed Zhao Xuance's eyes, then his smile deepened.

"Junior Brother Chen is indeed as rumored—possessing great composure." His gaze swept meaningfully over Chen Ji's dantian area. "However, some things can be hidden for a time, but not for a lifetime."

Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression grew even calmer.

He knew what the other was referring to. The aura of the Tianji Record, though mostly concealed by Mo Xiansheng's forbidden techniques, still faced the risk of exposure before such a person.

"Mr. Zhao jokes. Chen Ji is merely a servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect. What worth hiding could I possibly have?"

He smiled harmlessly, but beneath his eyes lay a dead, icy coldness.

Noted. When the time comes.

Zhao Xuance was in no hurry to expose the truth. He simply paced with hands clasped behind his back, as if admiring the scenery of Tianji Palace.

"Does Junior Brother Chen know what is sealed beneath Tianji Palace?"

Chen Ji's heart lurched.

The Dragon Vein. He knew. This palace itself was built on the nodes of the ancient Dragon Vein, the foundation upon which the Tianqing Sect was established. But he couldn't understand why Zhao Xuance would mention this before him.

"I know a little," he answered cautiously.

"Just a little?" Zhao Xuance chuckled lightly. "Then do you know, in three months, the Dragon Vein seal at the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds will face a loosening that occurs once every three hundred years?"

Chen Ji's pupils contracted.

Three months. The nearest great upheaval he had seen through the Tianji Record was exactly three months from now.

So that's it. The imperial dynasty's visit this time was probably not just for the fragment in his hands, but for the—

Dragon Vein.

dialogue.content:
"The Imperial City is determined to obtain the Dragon Vein."

Zhao Xuance suddenly changed his tone, his gaze turning sharp as a blade.

"But the Dragon Vein seal requires a key. And this key happens to share the same origin and root as the item in Junior Brother Chen's hands."

He stepped forward, the pressure suddenly intensifying.

"The Tianji Record."

These three words were like thunder, exploding beside Chen Ji's ears. The fragment in his dantian trembled even more violently, as if responding to some ancient summoning.

"His Highness the Crown Prince values talent and offers Junior Brother Chen an opportunity." Zhao Xuance took a jade slip from his sleeve. "Surrender the Tianji Record, and His Highness will not only ensure your safety in the coming chaos, but will also tell you a tremendous secret."

He extended the jade slip before Chen Ji, a confident弧度 curving his lips.

"Regarding your elder brother's whereabouts—Chen Tianming, is he still alive?"

text.content:
Chen Ji stared at the jade slip, his knuckles turning slightly white.

He knew this was a yang scheme. The Imperial City forces were too powerful, powerful enough that even the three great sects had to show them some deference. If he refused, the disaster awaiting him would be catastrophic; if he agreed, years of planning would be destroyed.

More critically—Chen Tianming.

That elder brother who had already become blurred in his memory. On the night the Chen family was destroyed, he had watched with his own eyes as his brother was taken away by mysterious figures, with no news since. He had countless times used the Tianji Record to deduce Chen Tianming's whereabouts, but every time had resulted in only chaos.

Now, the answer lay within this jade slip.

"Junior Brother Chen need not rush to answer." Zhao Xuance seemed to read through his struggle. "Three days from now, this old man will visit again. By then—"

His smile turned meaningful.

"I hope Junior Brother Chen can make the wise choice."

The entourage slowly departed, and that suffocating pressure dissipated with it.

Chen Ji stood alone beneath the palace gate, his expression gloomy enough to drip water.

He lowered his gaze to his palm—the Tianji Record Fragment was still trembling slightly, as if speaking of something.

"Master."

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying a rare gravity.

"This old one sensed it. On that Mr. Zhao, there is an extremely familiar aura—and that is... the aura of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets."

Chen Ji's heart shook.

"You're saying the Imperial City has the Eye of Heavenly Secrets behind it?"

"Not only that." Mo Xiansheng's voice grew even more low. "This old one just used the residual power to glimpse a corner—the jade slip does indeed contain Chen Tianming's whereabouts. But at the same time, it also conceals a trap that could cause Master to fall into utter destruction."

Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath.

He knew—this game was far more complicated than he had anticipated.

text.content:
Chen Ji let out a cold laugh and tossed the jade slip back to Zhao Xuance.

"Mr. Zhao, please convey to His Highness the Crown Prince—Chen Ji's things are not for others to take."

His tone was flat, yet carried undeniable resolve. At this moment, that废物's wretched aura completely vanished, replaced by a chilling edge that struck fear into the heart.

Zhao Xuance narrowed his eyes, as if reassessing this young man before him.

"Interesting." He retrieved the jade slip, his smile undiminished. "Junior Brother Chen truly is no ordinary fish in a shallow pond. Then this old man will return in three days—when the conversation may not be so pleasant."

After the entourage departed, Chen Ji immediately summoned his hidden operatives and began laying contingencies.

He was very clear—with the Tianqing Sect alone, it was impossible to resist the Imperial Dynasty. But he still had several cards in hand—the Night Qing of the Holy Sect on the Demonic Path, Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect, even the old Sect Master Ling Yuan—all were pieces that could be used.

The Imperial City wanted the Dragon Vein? Then let their opponents jump out first.

He wanted to see who would lose patience first in three days.

choices.description: Pretend to comply, buy time to thoroughly investigate the connection between the Imperial City and the Dragon Vein. Cooperate on the surface, scheme in secret, seek weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: Need to act, may be forced to surrender some interests
choices.visible_reward: Buy precious time, investigate more truth
choices.risk_hint: Imperial City's strategists are crafty and cunning; subpar acting may backfire

text.content:
Chen Ji accepted the jade slip, a hint of "struggle" and "vacillation" appearing on his face.

"Mr. Zhao... this matter is of great significance. Please allow me three days to consider."

Zhao Xuance nodded with satisfaction. "Junior Brother Chen is indeed a wise person. In three days, this old man awaits your good news."

He turned to board the sedan, but before departing, he added: "By the way, His Highness also instructed this old man to convey a message to Junior Brother Chen—your elder brother has been waiting for you over there for a long time."

Chen Ji's fingers gripping the jade slip trembled slightly—this time, it wasn't entirely an act.

Brother, where exactly are you?

After the entourage departed, Chen Ji immediately returned to his secret chamber and began divination using the Tianji Record.

He needed to clarify several matters within three days: the relationship between the Imperial City and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, Chen Tianming's specific whereabouts, and the truth behind the Dragon Vein seal.

Every thread of clues was fraught with danger, but every thread could become the key to breaking the deadlock.

Chen Ji opened his eyes, a fierce glint flickering within them.

Since you want to play, then I'll play this game to the end.

choices.description: Leak the news to other factions coveting the Dragon Vein, using them as pawns to create chaos so the Imperial Court is too occupied to act. This scheme is ruthless but could trigger even greater turmoil.
choices.visible_cost: Dragon Vein contention will intensify to a boiling point, potentially spiraling out of control
choices.visible_reward: The Imperial Court will be constrained by multiple forces, allowing Chen Ji to profit from the chaos

text.content:
Chen Ji did not rush to respond. Instead, through secret channels, he leaked the news that the 'Dragon Vein seal in the imperial capital will loosen in three months' to the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, the Xuanwu Sect, and interested parties within the Tianqing Sect.

The angles of information delivery varied, ensuring each faction believed only they knew this secret.

Next was simply watching from the mountain as tigers fought.

He wanted to see how much energy that strategist from the Crown Prince's residence would have left to deal with him when multiple forces simultaneously targeted the Dragon Vein.

Within half a day, responses came flooding in.

From the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, Ye Qing personally sent a message, expressing willingness for 'deep cooperation' to jointly face the coming upheaval.

The Xuanwu Sect remained motionless, but Han Lie's fighting spirit could no longer be contained—that fellow dreamed of clashing with the imperial capital.

What surprised Chen Ji most was the reaction from within the Tianqing Sect. The old Sect Master Ling Yuan actually summoned him, hinting at an intention to 'unite against external threats.'

Hmm, old fox.

He knew what Ling Yuan was scheming, but that didn't prevent him from using it. The enemy of my enemy is a piece that can be utilized.

That night, Chen Ji sat alone in the secret chamber, unfolding the Jade Slip.

Mo Xiansheng's warning still echoed in his ears, but he decided to take this risk anyway.

The information in the Jade Slip made his pupils constrict—

Chen Tianming, twelve years ago was taken into the core of the Heavenly Eye, imprisoned as a 'Prophet Candidate' to this day.

His consciousness remained, but his physical form had long merged with the Dragon Vein.

In other words, his brother had become part of the Dragon Vein seal.

「Master...」Mo Xiansheng's voice was heavy, 「This is the ultimate fate of all holders of the Tianji Record. Once bound to the Dragon Vein, there is no escape until completely devoured by the Heavenly Eye.」

Chen Ji gripped the Jade Slip tightly, his knuckles white.

Was his brother still alive? Was this form of existence liberation or torment for him?

And would he himself walk the same path?

At this moment, soft knocking came from outside the secret chamber.

「Chen Ji, it's me.」

It was Su Qingyao's voice.

Chen Ji gathered his thoughts and tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve. At the opened door, Su Qingyao stood in a plain white gown under the moonlight, rare worry evident in her brow.

「I heard someone from the imperial capital came.」 She met Chen Ji's eyes directly, 「Is it for you?」

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then nodded.

「What do they want?」

「The Tianji Record.」

Su Qingyao's gaze shifted, but she did not pursue the suspicion she had long harbored but never confirmed.

「How confident are you in handling this?」

「Seventy percent.」 Chen Ji gave a conservative estimate.

Su Qingyao watched him quietly, then softly said: 「What do you need me to do?」

This single sentence made a corner of Chen Ji's heart warm faintly.

「Help me watch Ling Yuan.」 He quickly suppressed that fleeting emotion, 「I feel he's playing a more complicated role in this than it seems.」

After Su Qingyao left, Chen Ji retrieved the Jade Slip and stared at that passage of text.

「Brother merged with the Dragon Vein...」

He murmured to himself, suddenly remembering something—why did those mysterious people take Chen Tianming when the Chen family was destroyed? Was it simply because he was the eldest legitimate son?

No.

The Chen family had another secret—their lineage was descended from the original owner of the Tianji Record.

And the year Chen Tianming was taken happened to be one year before the Tianji Record chose Chen Ji.

Was there some connection between these two events?

Chen Ji closed his eyes and activated the Tianji Record to begin divination.

This time, he did not predict the future, but traced the past.

He wanted to see what truly happened on that bloody night twenty years ago.

The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently, a torrential wave of information flooding into Chen Ji's mind—

He saw it.

Twenty years ago that night, the Chen family was ablaze, blood flowing like rivers. Young Chen Ji was hidden by his brother in the cellar, watching everything through a crack.

Those black-clad figures were indeed emissaries of the Heavenly Eye.

Their target from the very beginning was not the Chen family, but—

The Tianji Record.

Precisely, it was the inheritance of the Tianji Record.

They believed Chen Tianming was the chosen one, so they took him. Yet they never expected the Tianji Record would select Chen Ji afterward.

So, all these years of his brother's suffering was because—

He bore this burden in my place.

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, his chest feeling as if an invisible hand had seized it.

「Brother...」

He called out softly, his eyes flashing with killing intent he had never shown before.

Heavenly Eye. He would remember this.

choice.prompt: After learning the truth about his brother, Chen Ji faced a difficult choice: prioritize investigating and rescuing his brother, or continue his original plan to layout moves against the Imperial Court?

choices.risk_hint: The core of the Heavenly Eye is extremely dangerous, success rate extremely low

text.content:
Chen Ji rose abruptly, killing intent boiling in his eyes.

「Mo Xiansheng,」 his voice was low but firm, 「is there a way for me to enter the core of the Heavenly Eye?」

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment. 「There is. But three conditions must be met—the complete seven pages of the Tianji Record, sufficient Dragon Vein power, and...」

He paused.

「A sacrifice willing to open the road for you at the cost of themselves.」

Chen Ji sneered.

「Sacrifice? I am the best sacrifice there is.」

He turned toward the depths of the secret chamber, where lay his final trump card never before动用— an ancient teleportation talisman stolen from the Tianqing Sect's scripture depository.

This talisman could only be used once, the price being the user's entire Heavenly Fate.

But if it could rescue his brother, it was worth it.

choices.description: Restrain impulse, weaken the Imperial Court and other enemies according to the original plan. Wait for the situation to clarify before planning rescue, advancing steadily.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve trump cards, future actions will have more certainty
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best opportunity for rescue

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the restlessness in his heart.

「Mo Xiansheng,」 he sat back down, his voice returning to calm, 「when is the best timing to enter the core of the Heavenly Eye?」

「The day the Dragon Vein seal loosens.」 Mo Xiansheng answered, 「At that time, the Heavenly Eye's attention will be drawn to the Dragon Vein, and the core's defenses will show a brief vulnerability.」

「Three months from now?」

「Yes.」

Chen Ji nodded, the killing intent in his eyes gradually subsiding, replaced by bone-deep coldness.

「Fine. Then in these three months, sweep away all obstacles.」

He silently listed a string of names in his heart: Zhao Xuan, Ling Yuan, possible Demonic Path insiders, and—

The Heavenly Eye itself.

Three months. Enough time.

text.content: Chen Ji deliberated for a moment, then made a risky decision. He sought out Su Qingyao again. "There are some things I need to tell you." He handed her the Jade Slip, letting her read the passage about Chen Tianming. After reading it, Su Qingyao's expression slightly changed. "So, you've been hiding your strength all this time, for..." "For revenge, for finding the truth, and also—" Chen Ji paused, "to protect the people I care about." Su Qingyao watched him quietly, her eyes revealing complex emotions. After a long while, she softly said: "I knew long ago that you weren't a废物. But I never expected you to carry so much on your shoulders." She reached out and gently pressed her hand against Chen Ji's. "Tell me what you need. I'll help you." In that moment, Chen Ji felt a warm current flow from the back of his hand. He knew this was Su Qingyao opening her trust to him. And the雏形 of "Shared Fate" was quietly taking shape.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶已初步了解陈机真实身份

text.content: "Three days passed in an instant. That morning, Zhao Xuance's ceremonial entourage appeared again at the gate of Tianji Palace. Chen Ji stood before the palace gate, behind him Su Qingyao and several trusted subordinates, his expression showing not a trace of panic. Zhao Xuance descended from his sedan chair, his gaze sweeping over Chen Ji, a faint smile curving his lips. "Brother Chen, three days have passed. Have you made your decision?" Chen Ji smiled calmly, drawing a Jade Slip from his sleeve. "I've seen Brother Zhao's message." He tossed the Jade Slip to the other party. "However, I have some different ideas about the terms of cooperation." Zhao Xuance caught the Jade Slip, his spiritual sense probing within, his expression slightly shifting. "This is..." "The weaknesses of the Dragon Vein seal." Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back. "And the location of the key to pry it open." Light swirled in his eyes. "Instead of having His Highness go through so much trouble to seize the Tianji Record, why don't we join forces? In three months, each gets what they need."

Zhao Xuance fell silent for a long while, then suddenly burst into laughter. "Interesting!" He put away the Jade Slip, his gaze carrying more appreciation. "Brother Chen is truly not a man of the pond. This condition of yours, I can relay it on your behalf—but whether His Highness agrees, I dare not guarantee." "Naturally." Chen Ji nodded. "But Brother Zhao should also be aware that given His Highness's current predicament, there may be no better options." Zhao Xuance narrowed his eyes. "What do you know?" "Not much." Chen Ji smiled faintly. "But enough to convince Brother Zhao that I am not someone who can be easily manipulated." He paused, then shifted the topic. "Additionally, I wish to ask Brother Zhao for a favor." "Speak." "Deliver a message to your brother—" Chen Ji's voice dropped lower. "In three months, I'll come to retrieve him." Zhao Xuance's gaze flickered, then he nodded. "Very well. I'll relay the message." He turned to board the sedan chair, saying before his departure: "Brother Chen, I look forward to your performance."

After the entourage departed, Su Qingyao walked to Chen Ji's side, asking softly: "Do you really intend to cooperate with the imperial court?" Chen Ji shook his head, cold light flickering in his eyes. "Cooperate? No. I'm just buying time." "Then these intelligence reports..." "A mix of truth and falsehood." Chen Ji said calmly. "The Dragon Vein weaknesses I gave them are real, but the method to pry open the seal is false. In three months, when they enter the Dragon Vein's core, they'll discover—" A cold smile curled his lips. "Everything has been within my calculations." Su Qingyao looked at his profile, suddenly understanding something. This man was more terrifying than she had imagined. But at the same time, he was also more alone than she had imagined. She said nothing more, simply standing silently by his side, expressing her stance through action. Chen Ji glanced at her, a warmth flickering in the depths of his eyes. "Thank you." Only these two words, yet it was already his limit.

In the days that followed, Chen Ji began intensive preparations. He contacted Ye Qing, asking her to use the information network of the demonic Holy Sect to monitor movements in the imperial capital; he sent a secret letter to Han Lie, informing him of the Dragon Vein news to spark his fighting spirit; he performed an act in front of Ling Yuan, letting this old fox believe he was still in control. Every step was precise, every piece placed in the most suitable position. And he himself prepared the final trump card in secret—the Dragon Vein conflict three months later, he not only wanted to retrieve his brother but also intended to use this opportunity to completely uncover the secrets of the Heavenly Eye. "Master," Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, "are you certain about this? Once you fail, it will be utter destruction." Chen Ji stood at the highest point of Tianji Palace, gazing toward the distant imperial capital, a faint smile curving his lips. "Master Mo, do you know what I despise the most?" "What?" "Being treated as a chess piece." He turned around, unprecedented fire burning in his eyes. "Since Heaven wants to play, I'll play this game to the end. In three months, let's see—" "Is destiny unyielding, or can man triumph over heaven!"

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's dantian trembled violently again. He closed his eyes, tracing the source of that pull— In a trance, he saw a chaotic void. Deep within the void, a massive eye was watching him. That eye had no pupil, only endless depth and indifference, as if before it, all living beings were merely ants. "Finally... found you." An ancient and majestic voice exploded in his mind, carrying irresistible pressure. "The inheritor of the Tianji Record... the last bloodline of the Chen family..." Chen Ji's entire body stiffened, cold sweat instantly soaking his back. This was the Heavenly Eye! It had actually come to him actively! "Do not be alarmed." That voice continued. "I merely wish to see... what qualification you possess to bear this Tianji Record." "In three months, I await your performance." The voice faded, and that eye slowly dissipated, leaving only dead silence. Chen Ji猛地睁眼, finding himself still standing in place, as if everything just now had been merely an illusion. But he knew it was no illusion. The Heavenly Eye... was already watching him.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, calming his violently pounding heart. In that moment, he had felt true terror—an existence beyond his comprehension, the laws of heaven and earth themselves gazing upon him. But he felt no fear. Instead, an unprecedented battle intent blazed in his heart. "The Heavenly Eye..." he murmured, a cold smile curling his lips. "You've finally decided to reveal yourself?" He recalled what Mo Xiansheng had said—all prophecy fulfillers throughout history were merely chess pieces of Heaven, and the Tianji Record was nothing more than one of its instruments in the mortal realm. The Chen family's destruction, his brother's imprisonment, his own selection—perhaps all of this was within Heaven's calculations. But so what? He, Chen Ji, had never been a pawn to be manipulated. From this day forward, he would hold the chess pieces and ask this苍天— Who truly sits above the chessboard! In the distance, faint dragon cries echoed from the direction of the imperial capital, as if responding to his declaration. The Dragon Vein conflict three months later was no longer merely a power struggle, but a direct confrontation between man and Heaven. And Chen Ji was already prepared.
